name: Cinema Vlog Studio
summary: Rebuild a fixed 21-second cinematic street-vlog edit as an editable 1920x1080 Draft: 22 marker-driven cuts, a scramble title behind a closing black curtain, three inset cards that snap to full frame, and a bundled score.

compatibility.selects: Built and used in a Selects development build on macOS arm64 (2026-09-30). Requires Panel runScript and Draft authoring; the panel finds its sounds through the host FileSystem, with no shell command, so it also runs on Windows (a Windows pass on the Staging build is pending).

inputs.label: Title clip
inputs.hint: The street shot the title sits on, behind the black curtain.

inputs.label: Card clips
inputs.hint: Each opens as an inset card, then fills the frame.

inputs.label: Street clips
inputs.hint: The quick cuts around them; fewer than ten are reused.

prepare: City or street footage, ideally from one place
A title clip of at least 5.3 seconds

de.name: Cinema Vlog Studio
de.summary: Baut einen festen 21-sekündigen Kino-Straßenvlog als bearbeitbaren 1920x1080-Draft: 22 markergesteuerte Schnitte, ein Titel, der sich hinter einem schließenden schwarzen Vorhang zusammensetzt, drei Einschubkarten, die auf Vollbild springen, und mitgelieferte Musik.

en.name: Cinema Vlog Studio
en.summary: Rebuild a fixed 21-second cinematic street-vlog edit as an editable 1920x1080 Draft: 22 marker-driven cuts, a scramble title behind a closing black curtain, three inset cards that snap to full frame, and a bundled score.

es.name: Estudio de vlog de cine
es.summary: Recrea un montaje de vlog urbano de 21 segundos como un Draft editable de 1920x1080: 22 cortes guiados por marcadores, un título que se ordena tras un telón negro que se cierra, tres tarjetas que saltan a pantalla completa y música incluida.

fr.name: Studio de vlog cinéma
fr.summary: Reconstruit un montage de vlog de rue de 21 secondes en Draft 1920x1080 modifiable : 22 coupes pilotées par marqueurs, un titre qui se décode derrière un rideau noir qui se ferme, trois cartes qui passent en plein cadre et une musique fournie.

it.name: Studio vlog cinema
it.summary: Ricostruisce un montaggio da vlog urbano di 21 secondi come Draft 1920x1080 modificabile: 22 stacchi guidati dai marker, un titolo che si compone dietro un sipario nero che si chiude, tre card che passano a pieno schermo e musica inclusa.

ja.name: シネマ・ブログ・スタジオ
ja.summary: 21 秒の映画的なストリート vlog を、編集できる 1920x1080 の Draft として組み立てます。マーカーで決まる 22 のカット、閉じていく黒いカーテンの奥で文字が揃うタイトル、全画面へ切り替わる 3 枚のインセットカード、同梱の音楽が入ります。

ko.name: 시네마 브이로그 스튜디오
ko.summary: 21초짜리 시네마틱 거리 브이로그 편집을 편집 가능한 1920x1080 Draft로 다시 만듭니다. 마커로 정해지는 22개 컷, 닫히는 검은 커튼 뒤에서 글자가 맞춰지는 제목, 전체 화면으로 전환되는 카드 3개, 함께 제공되는 음악이 들어갑니다.

pt.name: Estúdio de vlog de cinema
pt.summary: Recria uma montagem de vlog de rua de 21 segundos como um Draft editável de 1920x1080: 22 cortes guiados por marcadores, um título que se ordena atrás de uma cortina negra que fecha, três cartões que passam a ecrã inteiro e música incluída.

tr.name: Sinema Vlog Stüdyosu
tr.summary: 21 saniyelik sinematik sokak vlog kurgusunu düzenlenebilir 1920x1080 bir Draft olarak yeniden kurar: işaretlerle belirlenen 22 kesme, kapanan siyah perdenin arkasında yerine oturan bir başlık, tam ekrana geçen üç kart ve pakete dahil müzik.

zh.name: 电影感 Vlog 工作室
zh.summary: 把 21 秒的电影感街头 vlog 重建为可编辑的 1920x1080 Draft：由标记决定的 22 个镜头、在闭合黑幕后逐字归位的标题、依次切到全屏的三张插卡，以及随附的配乐。
